content_of_post_to_comment: Having trouble developing your own philosophical system? Here’s a quick three-step method. Pick a some broad, impactful sounding word like “reason”, “capitalism”, or “God”. Think of a good metaphor for this concept. Carry the metaphor to its logical conclusion in all possible contexts. It’s very important that you don’t chicken out in step 3. People will start trying to shake your confidence with “counterexamples” or statements like “That doesn’t really make sense in this context.” Don’t be a coward. If the implications are crazy it just means you made an incredible philosophical discovery.
